summary.text: Monica Alponte, a Libertarian who described herself as a retired business writer, community leader, and former co-host of a conservative TV talk show, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 1st District to Amish Shah.
She ran on non-interventionist foreign policy, abolishing the IRS and Federal Reserve, and opposing government overreach into individual and property rights.

paragraphs.text: In her Ballotpedia survey, Alponte says she began to part ways with the major parties in 2008 and has spent the past 21 years working with her Arizona county on road and driver safety and on homeowners' association (HOA) reform.
She received 2.2% of the vote to Amish Shah's 52.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
